name: 94585 · Suisun City, CA
findings: ZIP 94585 (Suisun City) has 79 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94585 (Suisun City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 94585 (Suisun City) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
